trivia: The Library of Alexandria, founded around 295 BCE, was one of the ancient world's largest knowledge centers.
The word 'library' comes from the Latin 'liber', meaning book.
The Guinness World Record for the largest library is the Library of Congress with over 170 million items.
The first public library in the Philippines was established during the Spanish colonial period.
ISBN stands for International Standard Book Number — every published book has a unique one.
E-books now account for a significant share of library lending worldwide.
The Dewey Decimal System, created in 1876, is still used to organize books in many libraries.
